fusions.name: Splitting Flight
fusions.desc: Sends a knot of locusts into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of the damage. Your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Looses 2 swarms that part wide from each other, each one dealing 7 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Divided Host
fusions.desc: You split the swarm among every ally within 5 tiles: they strike 15% harder for 10 seconds and fight with 1 more power.

fusions.name: Branching Off
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, a locust splits away to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
